name: Uroboros, circulation and trickster
description: The native toroidal whole in eight movements: the round and its trickster costume, position, opposition, the metabolic fork, superposition, interposition (torus and winding), discharge/confinement, and the return with the hole intact.

scenes.name: The snake bends until its head meets its tail
scenes.character: The costume succeeds by making an actual feature exhaustive: head and tail complete a visible circumference, and the mouth, the depth, and the opening disappear into the outline.

entities.name: the uroboros — the body curving around an opening
head at tail — the mouth receiving its own body
the trickster — circle or sphere as costume; the visible completion offering itself as the whole truth
what the outline hides — mouth, depth, the opening kept

text.title: The snake bends until its head meets its tail
text.italic: The visible completion offers itself as the whole truth of the creature.

scenes.name: Position and opposition
scenes.character: Position gives the creature a face; the signed cancellation (-1)+(+1)=0 assigns completeness the office of a terminated account. Opposition restores head and tail as oriented terms.

entities.name: the circle seen as an outline — position
the filled perfection — sphere; the costume's first office
the signed cancellation — the terminated account; no place left for the mouth
head — reaches
tail — reached

text.title: Position gives the creature a face
text.italic: The costume makes an actual feature exhaustive; opposition restores the oriented terms.

scenes.name: The metabolic fork
scenes.character: Assimilation changes the receiver; Saturnine detention receives without generating; the Eden-serpent trades the hole for the fork.

entities.name: the mouth — the operative opening
assimilation — what enters changes the life that receives
Saturnine detention — the blocked gut; reception becomes detention
fusion — the mouth that takes every answer as confirmation
the Eden-serpent — the hole traded for the fork

text.title: Superposition is self-eating made bodily
text.italic: Assimilation changes the receiver; detention receives without generating.

scenes.name: Interposition — the toroidal winding
scenes.character: The four explicate field-lines and two implicates wind; the path γ(t)=[2t,−t] returns home while its lift ends at (2,−1).

entities.name: the torus — formed surface around an opening it cannot convert into surface
the opening — Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns it; Māyā the measure wound around it
the winding — four explicate field-lines and two implicates; the path returning home
the lifted endpoint (2, -1) — the homecoming retaining its displacement

text.title: Interposition — the toroidal winding
text.italic: The measure wound around the opening; the homecoming retains its displacement.

scenes.name: Discharge and confinement
scenes.character: Earthlight carries unconfined discharge; the tokamak holds charged plasma so its activity can continue within arranged containment. An opening is not simply a leak; containment need not be devouring closure.

entities.name: earthlight — the excluded ground's return as event
tokamak — the doughnut chamber; magnetic confinement
plasma held so its activity can continue
release and holding do different work — an opening not a leak; containment not devouring closure

text.title: Discharge and confinement
text.italic: An opening is not simply a leak; containment need not be devouring closure.

scenes.name: The Neumann ground and its variants
scenes.character: World parents, Prajāpati, En-Soph, the self-rolling wheel, Aion and Gebser — substantial differences in what the images do, not interchangeable costumes for the snake.

entities.name: mother and child — nourishment through differentiated dependency
Prajāpati's self-offering — the horse/universe image; a generative body
En-Soph; the self-rolling wheel — continuing formation about an opening
world parents — day and night, four directions; separation with the enduring relation
Jung's Self/shadow horizon; Gebser's changed seeing

text.title: The Neumann ground and its variants
text.italic: Substantial differences in what the images do — not interchangeable costumes.

scenes.name: The snake returns with its hole intact
scenes.character: Hunger still moves, but a received thing can change the terms of receiving. The Māyā-not-the-hole distinction stands; the eightfold recapitulation is complete.

entities.name: the round — wholeness keeping its opening
the intact hole — constitutive, not absent
living symbol / idol — the image's efficacy stays in relation to what it cannot exhaust
rest — the completed circuit coming to rest; the next circuit need not be demanded

text.title: The snake returns with its hole intact
text.italic: Hunger still moves, and a received thing can change the terms of receiving.
